sources.prompt: Create ONE Kalistar fantasy race emblem for the new race FACOCHE, a humanoid warthog people. Isolated cutout on a genuinely transparent RGBA background. Square canvas. Warthog head in powerful three-quarter view facing slightly LEFT, broad flattened snout with two visible nostrils, paired curved ivory-gold tusks, erect pointed ears, raised cheek pads, small intelligent amber eyes, short dark mane along crown. No glasses, no nose ring, no punk haircut, no character-specific costume: this represents the whole people, not Bebop individually. Noble imposing personality. Thick readable features that survive reduction to a 75-pixel motif, subtle etched fur and material patina, strong identifiable warthog silhouette. Centered with 10% clear margin, no part clipped. Not flat vector, cartoon, origami, glossy plastic, photoreal animal photo or modern UI icon. No background shadow or fake checkerboard: real transparent alpha outside the intrinsic head silhouette.

No pole, no hanging cords, no surrounding scene, no tassels or thick fringe, no ornate clutter, no text, no letters, no words or watermark. This is a fabric/emblem source image, not a finished card or UI.
